prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one 4:3 narrative frame for a cute Japanese anime character website.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Correct the physically impossible chair placement while preserving the character identity and clean cel-animation illustration style.
Primary correction: REMOVE the miniature chair from the tabletop. Recompose only the foreground and right side sufficiently to show a real desk corner and the wooden floor BELOW the tabletop. The desk must have a clearly visible front edge, right edge, vertical apron and support descending toward the floor. Put ONE NORMAL FULL-SIZE EMPTY MINT-GREEN ROLLING DESK CHAIR on that floor, to the right of the desk. The chair seat is substantially LOWER than the desktop; the chair back rises to the seated girl's shoulder level. All chair wheels rest on the low floor plane, with contact shadows, clearly separated vertically from the desktop. The chair must be usable by the girl, around three or four mug heights from wheel to top, not a toy. Preserve the mug on the tabletop at left of the desk corner; no overlap with the chair. The girl's near arm extends naturally to rest one hand on the chair back, and her other hand still holds her black digital stylus beside the drawing tablet. Her expression remains a cute, slightly shy invitation.
Preserve: the same silver-white long hair, bright blue eyes, round youthful face and pink hair bows; the same modest pink cat-ear hoodie, cream shirt; same pink strawberry wallpaper, bookcase, window, curtain, plush cat, digital tablet, warm honey wood and pink/mint/cream palette. Camera stays a coherent three-quarter 4:3 room view, with enough lower-right space for visible floor and adult-scale chair. No extra character.
Style: VERY CLEAN, crisp controlled outlines, flat clean color fills, simple deliberate two-band cel shading, no textured surfaces beyond restrained geometric details. The result must look like polished television-anime key art, with clear hands and strong geometrically consistent furniture silhouettes.
Avoid: any chair or wheels on the tabletop, toy or miniature chair, floating chair, floor at table height, merged or overlapping furniture, extra fingers, extra limbs, oil paint, watercolor, brush strokes, grain, dirt, haze, fuzzy edges, bloom, text, lettering or watermark.
Deliver one 4:3 landscape image, ideally 3840 by 2880.
pipeline: 内置 ImageGen 逐图清晰化；Pillow Lanczos 纯缩放响应式导出
resizeMethod: Lanczos；不添加锐化、纹理、降噪或调色滤镜
